theorem putnam_2020_a2

    -- RHS: 4^0 = 1
    simp [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top]
  | succ k ih =>
    -- Inductive step: assume true for k, prove for k+1
    -- Need to show ∑_{j=0}^{k+1} 2^{k+1-j} * C(k+1+j,j) = 4^{k+1}
    -- Use the identity C(n+1,r) = C(n,r) + C(n,r-1) to split the sum
    -- Then apply the inductive hypothesis

               2 ^ 0 * Nat.choose (2 * k + 2) (k + 1) := by
      calc
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 (k + 1), 2 ^ (k + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (k + 1 + j) j) =
            (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 (k + 1), 2 ^ (k + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (k + 1 + j) j) := rfl
        _ = (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 k, 2 ^ (k + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (k + 1 + j) j) +

          rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]

          <;> simp_all [Nat.sub_add_cancel, Nat.succ_le_iff]
          <;> omega
    rw [h₁]
